scope: Additive Electro Dragon chain-lightning integration. Earlier frozen references remain intact.
game_version: The numeric Electro Dragon rows remain the dated secondary build 18.600.3 record already incorporated into the 2026-09-17 reference. The chain mechanics sources do not publish a current client build.

sources.title: Meet The Electro Dragon!
sources.limitations: Establishes a five-target maximum, ground-and-air chain victims, descending damage, target class, housing and availability. It does not quantify individual decay, jump distance, victim ordering, projectile flight or death-bolt sequencing.

sources.title: Spring Update Full Release Notes
sources.limitations: Confirms a single lightning chain must not select the same target twice. It does not describe ordinary selection order or geometry.

sources.title: Electro Dragon
sources.limitations: Reports five total targets, a 20 percent multiplicative damage reduction per jump, no repeated victim, closest-then-highest-initial-HP selection and an at-most-one-empty-tile gap. It does not identify an immutable current client build, exact collision geometry, flight timing or death-bolt seed/order.

chain_damage_multiplier.note: Each successive victim receives 80 percent of the previous victim's damage. Core applies the multiplier sequentially, not as a flat secondary branch value.

chain_target_count.note: Five is the total victim cap, including the initial target.

chain_radius_tiles.note: Core interprets the documented maximum one-empty-tile gap as one tile between circular entity emprises. This is a secondary geometry approximation, not a published client-distance contract.

support.note: Core captures eligible victims and serializes one deterministic logical projectile per chain hit. Death lightning and precise flight or collision behavior remain unimplemented because their public contract is incomplete.

changed_values.previous_state: Current levels and primary attack values were catalogued, but the troop had no chain-lightning Core contract.
changed_values.replacement: Five-victim sequential chain with 20 percent multiplicative decay and no repeated target, shared by Core, CLI, Viewer and RL adapters.
changed_values.justification: The primary launch source establishes the five-target decreasing-damage chain and the later official fix prohibits duplicates. Secondary documentation supplies the decay and replaceable geometry or selection details.

known_uncertainties: The exact inter-target distance metric, geometry, projectile flight, target loss and intra-tick ordering are not published for a versioned current client.
The death lightning has six random ground strikes in secondary documentation, but its target radius, deterministic seed and per-bolt timing are unknown. It remains absent rather than approximated.
The secondary selection source uses highest initial hitpoints after distance. Core adds entity ID only as a deterministic final tie break.
conclusion: Electro Dragon is executable through shared adapters with a sourced bounded chain attack. It is not declared fully fidelity-verified because public death-lightning and detailed chain timing contracts remain open.
